title: request.json of an agent run
description: What started a role (<item>/agents/<agent_run_id>/request.json, agents.py start): written when the role starts. A folder with a request and no result is a role still running, or one that died with the process. agents.py start writes every field but parent_agent_run_id; only step is required, because cold recovery and agents.read take the rest as optional (a missing role comes from the step, a missing route is unknown).

agent_run_id.description: Id of the agent run (agent-<run suffix>-<n>).

step.description: Step of the role (executor.1, review.2, group-review-1, ...).

prompt.description: Prompt file, relative to the project.

causation.description: The step or problem that caused the start (question:<id>@<revision>, checks:<round>, findings:<round>).

parent_agent_run_id.description: The agent run whose answer this one mends (report-fixer).
